key_insight: Paper Circle presents an open-source multi-agent LLM framework that automates discovery, evaluation, and organization of scientific literature, dramatically reducing manual effort for literature review and synthesis.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing difficulty researchers face in efficiently finding, assessing, and synthesizing relevant papers from rapidly expanding scientific literature by providing an agent-driven, tool-enabled pipeline for research discovery and analysis.
method: Multi-agent architecture with specialized roles (retrieval, evaluator, synthesizer, organizer) that coordinate to handle distinct research tasks.
Agents leverage LLM capabilities plus tool integrations (e.g., search APIs, PDF parsers, citation graphs) to retrieve, rank, and extract key insights from papers.
Open-source framework and pipelines with interactive workflows for iterative queries, summarization, and structured organization of findings.
impact: Helps AI/ML practitioners scale literature reviews, speed up hypothesis generation, and improve reproducibility by turning fragmented paper search and analysis into a coordinated, automated workflow.
visual_elements: Flowchart of multi-agent pipeline (query → retrieval → evaluation → synthesis → organization)
Ranked-results mockup or relevance heatmap showing paper scoring and key highlights
Interactive UI mockup illustrating an end-to-end query and synthesized summary
Citation-network graph highlighting clusters and influential papers
paper_title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework
paper_authors: Komal Kumar, Aman Chadha, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Hisham Cholakkal
